name: Aucilla Sinks (Florida Trail, Aucilla Wildlife Management Area)
area: Goose Pasture Road, Aucilla WMA, Jefferson/Taylor county line
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Florida Trail kiosk on Goose Pasture Road, Aucilla Wildlife Management Area (off Powell Hammock Road, north of US 98)
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Start at the Florida Trail kiosk on Goose Pasture Road and hike south along the Sinks portion, where the river pops up in one sink after another before going underground again, ending at the final rise (Nutall Rise) near US 98. A 4.4-mile hike covers the most dramatic stretch; out-and-back works fine.
cost: Free (no fee listed by the Florida Trail chapter or FWC birding-trail page)
access: Walk-in from roadside pullouts on Goose Pasture Road or the south-end dirt road off Powell Hammock Road; park at your own risk. Do not hike near flood stage. No potable water.

conditions.summary: Aucilla WMA general gun season runs Nov 7, 2026-Jan 3, 2027, covering the whole trip window. FWC's birding-trail page says the Florida National Scenic Trail is open to hikers all year; the Florida Trail Association chapter page says 'Closed during general hunting season.' Sources conflict. If going, wear blaze orange and call SRWMD 386-362-1001 or FWC to confirm. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

name: Fore Lake Campground
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Fore Lake Campground, Fort McCoy, FL
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Thirty-one sites in oak and pine shade on Fore Lake with a swimming beach, fishing pier and bathhouse. The handiest cheap forest campground for Silver Springs State Park and the Silver River. Gate open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' This is a designated campground, so it stays legal for the whole trip. Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.
